Hi Sophie — thanks for the details and the snapshot. Quick answers up front, followed by a short proposal outline we can formalize for procurement: 

Retain vs Metered (short):
- Slab (recommended for predictable workloads): fixed monthly price for defined retention buckets (30/90/365d). Best when you want capex-like predictability.
- Metered: pay per GB ingested/retained; gives lower entry price for spiky workloads but costs scale linearly with volume.

Tracing / high-cardinality:
- No hard licensing cap; we meter by retained spans and index cardinality. We include automatic sampling tiers (adaptive sampling) to control cost. If you need full-fidelity for specific services, we provide targeted retention rules with an incremental surcharge.

Advanced dashboards:
- Packaged as part of the Insights Bundle (includes 10 dashboard templates + two custom dashboards). Seats are not required for read-only viewers; edit seats are licensed per seat.

Discounting & pilot:
- Typical path: pilot credits for 3 months (trial support + credits) + conversion to 12-month annual commit. We can offer a commit discount tied to annual spend. For a pilot that converts to a 12-month commit at the volumes you shared, I can propose a commercial path with either: 
  a) 12% off list for year 1 with a 12-month commitment + standard onboarding credit, or
  b) larger onboarding credit (one-off) + 8% list discount if procurement prefers lower recurring discount.

I'll put together a short procurement-ready proposal (PDF) and a granular pricing XLS with slab vs metered scenarios. For the proposal, can you confirm:
- who in procurement should I send the formal DocuSign to?
- any internal approval thresholds (discount >10% requires finance sign-off)?
